probes.label: Plain sentence
probes.question: What wrapper does the engine inject, and is the original TextNode detached?

probes.label: Value between two text runs
probes.question: Does the engine give the number its own segment, or merge the sentence?

probes.label: Bare number
probes.question: Does a pure number get wrapped at all?

probes.label: Conditional text with a sibling
probes.question: The removeChild crash shape. Is the text node detached while the sibling stays?

probes.label: Nested inline elements
probes.question: Does the engine reorder inline elements for target-language word order?
probes.before: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
probes.after: Le renard brun rapide saute par-dessus le chien paresseux
probes.html: Le renard brun rapide saute par-dessus le chien paresseux

probes.label: List items
probes.question: Are list items translated independently or merged into one segment?

probes.label: Attributes (title, alt, placeholder)
probes.question: Does the engine translate attributes, and does that mutate the DOM?
probes.html: Plaider moi

probes.label: translate="no"
probes.question: Is the documented opt-out actually honoured by this engine?

probes.label: class="notranslate"
probes.question: Is the legacy Google opt-out honoured by this engine?

probes.label: Input value
probes.question: Does the engine rewrite form values the app reads back?

probes.label: Shadow DOM
probes.question: Does the engine reach into a shadow root? Nobody has documented this.
probes.before: There are 4 lights inside a shadow root!
probes.after: There are 4 lights inside a shadow root!

probes.label: Singular agreement
probes.question: Grammar risk: what does the target language do at 1?
probes.before: There is 1 light in the room.
probes.after: Il y a 1 lumière dans la pièce.
probes.html: Il y a 1 lumière dans la pièce.

probes.label: Plural agreement
probes.question: Compare with the singular probe. If they differ, digit swapping is unsafe.
probes.before: There are 5 lights in the room.
probes.after: Il y a 5 lumières dans la salle.
probes.html: Il y a 5 lumières dans la salle.

probes.label: Digit systems and separators
probes.question: Does the engine reshape digits or number separators for the target locale?
probes.before: Prices: 1,234.56 and 21 and 100% on the 3rd of May 2026

probes.label: Sustained updates target
probes.question: Under many writes per second, does the engine loop or fall behind?

probes.label: Content added after translation
probes.question: Does the engine re-translate late content, and how fast?
probes.after: En attente de l'expérienceIl y a 8 lumières ajoutées tardivement!Il y a 8 lumières ajoutées tardivement!
